keys: AAC 音频码率；未启用音频时不参与导出。
en: AAC audio bitrate; unused when no audio is enabled.

keys: Ctrl+H 显示 / 隐藏界面，Esc 恢复界面，F10 窗口调整为 16:9，F11 全屏
en: Ctrl+H show/hide the UI, Esc restore it, F10 fit the window to 16:9, F11 fullscreen

keys: 两者共享波动和触键响应。关闭染色后保持自定义颜色，仍随触键增亮和波动。
en: Both share the wobble and key-press response. With note tinting off they keep custom colors and still brighten and wobble on key presses.

keys: 为画面中较亮的效果添加光晕，影响所有发光效果。
en: Adds a halo to brighter effects on screen; affects every glow.

keys: 也可以将文件拖入窗口
en: You can also drag files into the window

keys: 仅调整背景视频预览帧率；导出跟随导出窗口的帧率。
en: Only affects the background video preview FPS; export follows the export dialog frame rate.

keys: 仅调整背景视频预览；导出使用原视频。
en: Only affects the background video preview; export uses the original video.

keys: 从触键位置向两侧扩散，只显示在键盘区域。
en: Spreads sideways from the pressed key, visible only over the keyboard.

keys: 位置与尺寸（画面百分比）
作用于整个按下的键面。关闭发光后，仍保留按下状态的颜色。
en: Covers the whole pressed key. With key glow off, the pressed color is kept.

keys: 使用乐谱内的 MIDI 同步。播放、暂停与拖动共用下方时间轴；透明乐谱可配浅色主颜色。
en: Syncs with the MIDI embedded in the score. Play, pause and scrubbing share the timeline below; transparent scores pair well with a light primary color.

keys: 关闭后播放到视频末尾时保持最后一帧。
en: When off, the last frame is held once playback reaches the end of the video.

keys: 去除 SVG 白底和乐谱衬板，显示透明乐谱
en: Remove the SVG white background and score backing for a transparent score

keys: 发声点到达时增亮，随后衰减回基础亮度。乐谱和光标参与全局泛光。
en: Brightens as notes reach the strike point, then decays back to base. The score and cursor join the global bloom.

keys: 可执行文件名或完整路径
同一通道包含多个轨道时，可按轨道分别配色。两种模式各自保留颜色。
en: When one channel spans multiple tracks, colors can follow each track. Both modes keep their own colors.

keys: 同时调整此组音符与按下琴键的颜色
en: Also adjusts the colors of this note group and the pressed keys

keys: 圆点粒子独立启停。尺寸按 1080p 画面计算。
en: Dot particles start and stop independently. Sizes are measured on a 1080p frame.

keys: 圆角半径按 1080p 画面计算；窄、短音符会自动限制圆角大小。
en: Corner radius is measured on a 1080p frame; narrow and short notes clamp it automatically.

keys: 展开 / 折叠接触线系统设置
en: Expand / collapse contact line system settings

keys: 展开 / 折叠灯光设置
展开 / 折叠粒子与流线设置
恢复共享气流与运动参数
恢复接触线与光带响应参数
en: Reset contact line & light bar response

keys: 恢复自动检测，检查常见安装目录、系统安装信息和 PATH
en: Re-run auto-detection over common install folders, system install info and PATH

keys: 恢复近键音符增亮参数
按下时使用音符的分组颜色。调整布局同时移动音符列与命中位置。
en: Pressed keys use the note group colors. Adjusting the layout moves note columns and hit positions together.

keys: 按编码速度从快到慢排列；慢速预设通常有更好的压缩效率。
en: Ordered fastest to slowest; slower presets usually compress better.

keys: 接触线周围的柔光。取消颜色跟随后可单独选色，原来的独立颜色会保留。像素按 1080p 画面计算。
en: Soft glow around the contact line. Once it stops following the line color it can be picked freely; the previous custom color is kept. Pixels are measured on a 1080p frame.

keys: 提高音符的发光亮度；外围光晕由「全局泛光」控制。
en: Raises note glow; the outer halo is controlled by Global bloom.

keys: 数值越低，画质越高，文件通常越大。不同编码器的相同 CRF 不代表相同画质。
en: Lower values mean higher quality and usually larger files. The same CRF is not the same quality across encoders.

keys: 显示 / 隐藏右侧设置栏
未找到可用的 FFmpeg，无法导出视频。请从官网下载安装：[url=https://ffmpeg.org/download.html#build-windows]ffmpeg.org/download.html#build-windows[/url]，安装后重新打开本窗口即可自动识别，或在上方填写 ffmpeg.exe 的完整路径。
en: No usable FFmpeg found; video export is unavailable. Download it from the official site: [url=https://ffmpeg.org/download.html#build-windows]ffmpeg.org/download.html#build-windows[/url]. After installing, reopen this window to auto-detect it, or type the full path to ffmpeg.exe above.

keys: 正值延后到 MIDI 后面的小节；负值跳过乐谱开头的小节。外部同步暂不支持反复，拍号与小节顺序需一致。
en: Positive shifts into measures after the MIDI; negative skips measures at the score start. External sync does not support repeats yet; time signatures and measure order must match.

keys: 正值延后；负值跳过音频开头。
en: Positive delays; negative skips into the audio.

keys: 正值延迟视频开始；负值跳过视频开头。
en: Positive delays the video; negative skips into it.

keys: 此路径保存在本机，所有项目共用。选择 .mscz 后自动转换；未修改的谱面复用缓存。
en: This path is stored locally and shared by all projects. Picking a .mscz converts automatically; unchanged scores reuse the cache.

keys: 沿琴键顶端延伸的亮线；与光带分别控制。像素按 1080p 画面计算。
en: A bright line along the top edge of the keys; controlled separately from the light bar. Pixels are measured on a 1080p frame.

keys: 点击展开 / 折叠此组设置
en: Click to expand / collapse this group

keys: 画面内显示的音符时间范围。数值越大，画面覆盖的时间越长，音符下落越慢。
en: Time span of notes shown on screen. Larger values cover more time, so notes fall slower.

keys: 移除 MIDI、关联音频和乐谱
en: Remove MIDI, linked audio and score

keys: 移除乐谱，保留当前 MIDI
en: Remove the score, keep the current MIDI

keys: 粒子与流线共用这组基准，流线略快上升、寿命略长。速度按 1080p 画面计算；两者关闭后参数仍保留。
en: Particles and streams share this baseline; streams rise slightly faster and live slightly longer. Speeds are measured on a 1080p frame; settings persist when either is disabled.

keys: 统一设置谱线、音符及记号的颜色
en: Set one color for staff lines, notes and marks

keys: 背景素材在快速设置中选择。图片和视频共用效果；不透明度降低时显露底色。
en: Background media is chosen in Quick settings. Images and videos share the effects; lowering opacity reveals the base color.

keys: 范围外的音符不显示；MIDI 文件与时间轴保持原样。
en: Notes outside the range are hidden; the MIDI file and timeline are untouched.

keys: 要调整的通道 / 轨道
视频导出依赖外部 FFmpeg（未随应用分发）。
en: Video export relies on an external FFmpeg (not bundled).

keys: 视频跟随 MIDI 时间；预览默认 720p / 30 FPS。FFmpeg 路径在导出窗口中设置；背景视频自身音轨不参与播放与导出。
en: The video follows MIDI time; preview defaults to 720p / 30 FPS. The FFmpeg path is set in the export dialog; the background video's own audio track is not played or exported.

keys: 触键时增强靠近键盘的音符亮度，可独立于按键发光启用。像素按 1080p 画面计算。
en: Brightens notes near the keyboard on key presses; can run independently of key glow. Pixels are measured on a 1080p frame.

keys: 选择 FFmpeg 可执行文件
选择 MuseScore 乐谱或 JSON 数据包，同时载入同源 MIDI
en: Select a MuseScore score or JSON bundle; the matching MIDI loads with it

keys: 长短音符均可触发，关闭粒子也可单独显示。触发后松键仍会完整消散。粗细按 1080p 画面计算。
en: Short and long notes both trigger it, and it can run with particles off. Releasing the key lets it fade out fully. Width is measured on a 1080p frame.

keys: 降低预览规格可减少显卡负担。F10 将窗口调整为 16:9；F11 全屏。导出使用独立的分辨率和帧率。
en: Lower preview specs reduce GPU load. F10 fits the window to 16:9; F11 fullscreen. Export uses its own resolution and frame rate.

keys: 音符与琴键接触位置的小范围亮光。
en: A small glow where notes meet the keys.

keys: 项目 MIDI 无法载入
en: Project MIDI could not be loaded
